explore-lengthen.title: Move it down the band
explore-lengthen.prompt: Set the dipole's length so it resonates on 3.6 MHz.
hints: Lower frequency needs a longer antenna.
explore-lengthen.success: About 39.7 m. Longer wire, lower resonant frequency.

explore-shorten.title: Move it up the band
explore-shorten.prompt: Set the length so it resonates on 3.9 MHz.
explore-shorten.success: Shorter wire, higher resonant frequency: about 36.7 m.
